title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. However, with busy schedules, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 simple and tasty cook-once recipes that can help pregnant women prepare quick and nutritious dinners.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide adequate protein, fiber, and calcium, which are essential for maintaining the health of both mother and baby. According to the [WHO](https://www.who.int/tools/elena/interventions/nutrition-counselling-pregnancy), nutrition counseling during pregnancy is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Vegetable Soup
Chicken and vegetable soup is a simple and nutritious meal. Pregnant women can use chicken cooked with various vegetables such as carrots, potatoes, and onions. According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html), cooking chicken and vegetables is essential to avoid food poisoning.

### 2. Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry
Beef and vegetable stir-fry is a simple and quick recipe. Pregnant women can use beef cooked with various vegetables such as broccoli, carrots, and onions. According to the [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/keeping-well/have-a-healthy-diet/), eating a balanced and varied diet is essential to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

### 3. Egg and Salad Recipe
Egg and salad recipe is a simple and nutritious meal. Pregnant women can use eggs cooked with various vegetables such as lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers. According to the [ACOG](https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/nutrition-during-pregnancy), eating a balanced and varied diet is essential to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a simple and nutritious recipe. Pregnant women can use yogurt cooked with various fruits such as strawberries, bananas, and oranges. According to the [NIH ODS](https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/Folate-HealthProfessional/), eating a balanced and varied diet is essential to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

### 5. Grilled Chicken with Potatoes
Grilled chicken with potatoes is a simple and nutritious recipe. Pregnant women can use chicken grilled with potatoes and various vegetables such as broccoli, carrots, and onions. According to the [EPA/FDA](https://www.epa.gov/fish-tech/epa-fda-advice-about-eating-fish-and-shellfish), eating a balanced and varied diet is essential to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

## Food Safety Notes
When preparing meals, pregnant women should note food safety to avoid food poisoning. According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html), cooking chicken and vegetables is essential to avoid food poisoning.

## Conclusion
Preparing healthy and delicious meals is essential to ensure the health of both mother and baby. With these 5 simple and tasty cook-once recipes, pregnant women can prepare quick and nutritious dinners. To learn more about pregnancy nutrition, pregnant women can visit our [website](/blog) for advice and support.
